# StudyPal & SkillConnect – Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

StudyPal & SkillConnect is a student-focused web application developed for WDD430 – Web Full-Stack Development at BYU-Idaho.

## Technology Stack

- Next.js
- React
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS

## Project Features

- Student registration and authentication
- Student profiles
- Course management
- Course-based student search
- Study group management
- Study group membership
- Student dashboard

## Coding Guidelines

- Use TypeScript for application development.
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions.
- Use reusable React components.
- Keep components organized and maintainable.
- Use descriptive variable and function names.
- Follow consistent formatting and indentation.
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling.
- Ensure responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
- Use accessible HTML elements and labels.
- Avoid duplicating code when reusable components are appropriate.

## Development Guidelines

- Follow the existing project structure.
- Review existing code before creating new components.
- Keep changes focused on the requested feature.
- Test changes locally before committing.
- Do not commit secrets, credentials, or environment files.

## Team Collaboration

- Use GitHub issues to track development tasks.
- Follow the Week 04 milestone priorities.
- Create branches for development work.
- Submit pull requests for review before merging.
